setup: CREATE TABLE tenk1(unique1 integer, unique2 integer)
CREATE TABLE review_keys(y integer NOT NULL)
INSERT INTO review_keys SELECT unique1 FROM tenk1
CREATE FUNCTION public.review_accumulate(integer, integer) RETURNS integer LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE STRICT AS 'SELECT $1 + $2'
CREATE AGGREGATE public.review_sum(integer) (SFUNC = public.review_accumulate, STYPE = integer, INITCOND = '0')
